# Hideout Boutique

> Med spa in Fort Myers, Florida, since 2017, founded by Jennifer Linzalone Sepielli, CAA. A medical team (a medical director, a nurse practitioner and a registered nurse), licensed estheticians, and lash and permanent makeup artists work under one roof. 1342 Colonial Blvd, Suite H57, Fort Myers, FL 33907, just south of Colonial Boulevard and east of McGregor Boulevard. Phone 239-936-0758, email HideoutBoutique@gmail.com. By appointment only, with flexible hours. Online booking through Boulevard: https://www.joinblvd.com/b/hideout-boutique/widget. Clients come from Fort Myers, Cape Coral, Estero, Bonita Springs and Naples. Every plan starts with a consultation and pairs treatments in the spa with care at home.

## Team

- [Dr. Davek Sharma, MD](https://www.hideoutboutique.com/#team): medical director.
- [Lina Davis, NP-C](https://www.hideoutboutique.com/#team): nurse practitioner and aesthetic injector; does every injection at Hideout (Botox, filler, facial balancing, bio-regenerative treatments); Smooth PDO and aesthetic ultrasound provider. "Honesty matters to us more than booking a large treatment. If your concerns can be addressed conservatively, we'll say so."
- [Jennifer Linzalone Sepielli, CAA](https://www.hideoutboutique.com/#team): founder; certified anesthesiologist assistant, licensed esthetician, licensed permanent makeup artist, lash artist, licensed electrologist and laser technician.
- [Jessica Mostacero](https://www.hideoutboutique.com/#team): licensed esthetician, medical assistant and phlebotomist; permanent makeup (brows, areola, scalp) and scalp micropigmentation.
- [Diana Fermin, RN](https://www.hideoutboutique.com/#team): registered nurse and licensed esthetician. The team also includes estheticians Brandi Spahr (acne and corrective skincare), Madison Passantino, Melanie Sanchez, Bailey Peale, Priscilla Garrido and Eric Aponte, and client care by Mabel Luis (also permanent makeup and makeup), Lindsey Adams, Cali Binns and Chloe Waddel.

## Treatments

- [Facials and body, 17 treatments](https://www.hideoutboutique.com/#treatments): Made For Me Signature and Platinum facials, HydraFacial (with the JLO Beauty booster), AquaFirmeXS (stem cell facial, no downtime, also for the scalp), an organic stem cell treatment (EXO|E, eleven days), Face Reality acne program, Teen Spirit, Bacial (back facial), couples facial; specialty facials Red Carpet, Fire & Ice, 24k Gold, The Contour and The Zen; Baby Bump facial (second and third trimesters), body wraps, ultrasonic cavitation.
- [Skin and lasers, 20 treatments](https://www.hideoutboutique.com/#treatments): SkinPen microneedling (30 to 60 minutes, redness up to 2 to 4 days, 2 or 3 sessions 4 to 6 weeks apart), Collagen P.I.N., Morpheus8 (2 to 10 days of social downtime, 3 sessions or more), Scarlet RF (about 30 minutes after numbing, 3 sessions), AGNES RF; chemical peels, BioRePeel (no downtime, 4 to 6 sessions every 1 to 2 weeks), PRX-T33; Lumecca IPL photofacial (best suited to lighter skin tones, 3 to 5 sessions about 4 weeks apart), Fotona 4D, Fotona peel (up to a week of redness and peeling), Tetra CO2 CoolPeel (redness and mild swelling for a day or two), Deka Peel, LipLase, NightLase (snoring, 3 or 4 sessions over two months), TightSculpt, hair restoration, Discovery Pico (pigment and tattoo removal, permanent makeup included), laser hair removal (InMode DiolazeXL and Fotona Nd:YAG), vein treatment.
- [Injectables, 7 treatments](https://www.hideoutboutique.com/#treatments), all by Lina Davis, NP-C: Tox such as Botox or Jeuveau (15 to 20 minutes, no downtime, full result at two weeks with a follow-up, lasts 3 to 4 months), hyaluronic acid filler (6 to 12 months or longer), lips, facial balancing, restorative plasma (Cellenis Derma), Smooth PDO threads, Sculptra (results that can last up to two years).
- [Lashes, 5 treatments](https://www.hideoutboutique.com/#treatments): classic, hybrid, volume and mega volume extensions by three levels of lash artists, and lash lift. Fills every 2 to 3 weeks.
- [Permanent makeup, 6 treatments](https://www.hideoutboutique.com/#treatments): microblading, ombré powder brows, eyeliner, lip blush, areola pigmentation and scalp micropigmentation, by Jen, Jessica and Mabel. Most permanent makeup takes two sessions.
- [Also at Hideout](https://www.hideoutboutique.com/#treatments): permanent jewelry (walk-ins welcome), teeth whitening, makeup for events by Mabel (glam $125, bridal $150, bridal trial $50), waxing and threading.
- [By concern](https://www.hideoutboutique.com/#treatments): lines and wrinkles, acne, dark spots and discoloration; each concern lists the treatments that address it.

## Results

- [Before and after](https://www.hideoutboutique.com/#results): 38 before-and-after photos from Hideout's own clients (16 injectables, 8 skin and lasers, 5 lashes, 9 permanent makeup), each naming the treatment and the provider when she signs her work. Results vary from person to person.

## Memberships and payment

- [Beauty Bank](https://www.hideoutboutique.com/#memberships): $99 a month or more, credited to your account, with a three-month minimum; the money never expires and can be spent on any service or product. Members get $1 off per unit of Tox, $50 off a syringe of filler, $150 off a package of CoolPeels, $300 off a package of Deka Peels, 10% off products, 10% off PDO threads, teeth whitening, HydraFacials, Morpheus8 and IPL, microneedling, IV hydration, VI Peels and laser hair removal sessions, and a birthday gift. Some exclusions apply.
- [Skin Health](https://www.hideoutboutique.com/#memberships): $175 a month for a Signature HydraFacial MD or an AquaFirmeXS every month, plus 10% off skincare products and 15% or more off facial upgrades.
- [Perfectly Bare](https://www.hideoutboutique.com/#memberships): $100 a month for laser hair removal on one area every month; more areas $75 each.
- [Paying over time](https://www.hideoutboutique.com/#memberships): CareCredit is accepted; payment plans with Cherry.

## Visit

- [Find the hideout](https://www.hideoutboutique.com/#visit): 1342 Colonial Blvd, Suite H57, Fort Myers, FL 33907. By appointment only. Arrive 15 minutes early; forms are emailed when you book. Cancel at least 24 hours ahead: late cancellations lose the booking fee or are charged 50% of the service, and no-shows 100%. After 15 minutes late, the appointment may need to be rescheduled.
- [Before your treatment](https://www.hideoutboutique.com/procedure-pre-care-instructions/) and [after your treatment](https://www.hideoutboutique.com/post-procedure-instructions/): instructions for each treatment.
- [Skincare shop](https://www.hideoutboutique.com/shop-skin-care/): medical-grade products such as SkinBetter Science, Alumier and Grande Cosmetics.
